blocks.orig: Exploring all that Tanzania has to offer is a dream for many. From epic Tanzania safari adventures spotting Africa’s Big Five, to climbing Kilimanjaro or relaxing on the paradise beaches of Zanzibar: Tanzania has it all. Good news: Your Tanzania Trip can build a custom made itinerary that suits all your wishes.
blocks.html: Many people dream of discovering everything Tanzania has to offer. Whether it is an epic Tanzania safari in search of Africa’s Big Five, a Kilimanjaro climb or time on the paradise beaches of Zanzibar: you will find it all in Tanzania. The good news is that Your Tanzania Trip can put together a custom made itinerary that fits all your wishes.

blocks.orig: Our most popular itineraries can help you find some inspiration. Most of our clients love to end their exciting safari with a few days of relaxation on one of Zanzibar’s most stunning beaches. Would you like that as well?
blocks.html: For some inspiration, take a look at our most popular itineraries. Most of our guests like to round off their exciting safari with a few relaxing days on one of Zanzibar’s most beautiful beaches. Does that appeal to you too?

blocks.orig: Whether you choose one of our popular Tanzania itineraries or prefer to customize your journey, we are here to assist you. Come aboard and get ready to explore Tanzania at your own pace, exactly the way you like it!
blocks.html: Whether you go for one of our popular Tanzania itineraries or would rather shape your own journey, we are happy to help. Join us and get ready to discover Tanzania at your own pace, just the way you want!

blocks.orig: Welcome to Tanzania! Upon your arrival at Dar es Salaam Airport, our friendly and knowledgeable guide will be eagerly waiting to warmly welcome you. He will be readily available to assist you and ensure a smooth transfer to your hotel. Sit back, relax, and let us take care of all your travel needs, providing you with a memorable and unforgettable experience in Tanzania.
blocks.html: Karibu, welcome to Tanzania! When you land at Dar es Salaam Airport, our friendly guide, who knows the country well, is waiting to give you a warm welcome. He is there to help you and to make sure your transfer to the hotel goes smoothly. Sit back and relax while we look after everything you need, so your time in Tanzania becomes a memorable experience.

blocks.orig: Today you fly from Dar Es Salaam to Kigoma, on the western side of the country. When you arrive, a driver is waiting to bring you to your hotel, after which there is plenty of time to go for example on a city tour, visit a historial town or a nearby village, or go for boat ride on Lake Tanganyika. The next day it's all about the chimpanzees!
blocks.html: Today's flight takes you from Dar Es Salaam to Kigoma, in the west of the country. On arrival a driver is ready to take you to your hotel, and afterwards you have lots of time for, say, a city tour, a visit to a historic town or a village nearby, or a boat trip on Lake Tanganyika. Tomorrow the focus is entirely on the chimpanzees!

blocks.orig: Have you always dreamed of seeing chimps in their natural habitat? Then by all means visit the Gombe Stream National Park where Jane Goodall once did her behavioural research on chimpanzee populations. This small national park lies along the western border of Tanzania on the eastern shores of Lake Tanganyika, where it is only accessible by boat. Step into the footsteps of Jane Goodall as a guide takes you to watch groups of chimpanzees climb trees, play or nurse their babies!
blocks.html: Have you long wished to see chimps in the wild? Then Gombe Stream National Park is the place to go, as this is where Jane Goodall once carried out her research into the behaviour of chimpanzee groups. The small park sits on Tanzania's western border along the eastern shore of Lake Tanganyika, and you can only get there by boat. Follow in Jane Goodall's footsteps as a guide leads you to groups of chimpanzees climbing trees, playing or caring for their young!

blocks.orig: Experience the ultimate adventure as you embark on a drive and boat transfer from Kigoma to Mbali Mbali Lodge Mahale. Witness the breathtaking beauty of the landscapes while enjoying a comfortable and convenient journey. Immerse yourself in the wonders of nature and prepare to be captivated by the stunning views along the way. With our expertly planned itinerary, every detail of your trip is taken care of, ensuring a seamless and memorable experience.
blocks.html: Enjoy a real adventure as you travel by road and by boat from Kigoma to Mbali Mbali Lodge Mahale. Take in the beautiful scenery on a comfortable, easy journey. Let yourself be absorbed by the wonders of nature and the lovely views along the route. Our carefully planned itinerary looks after every detail of your trip, so everything runs smoothly and the journey stays with you.

blocks.orig: More chimpanzees await you in the Mahale Mountains National Park. At a 2.5-hour drive and a boat ride from Gombe National Park, this park is a bit larger and home to roughly 900 wild chimpanzees. The park is different from most since there are no roads and you have to go on foot. Experienced guides take you on a hike through the mountains in search of groups of chimpanzees. Once found, you get plenty of time to observe these beauties - a magical experience!
blocks.html: Even more chimpanzees are waiting for you in Mahale Mountains National Park. A 2.5-hour drive plus a boat trip from Gombe National Park, this park is slightly bigger and has around 900 wild chimpanzees. It differs from most parks in that there are no roads, so you explore on foot. Experienced guides lead you on a walk through the mountains to look for chimpanzee groups. When you find them, you have lots of time to watch these wonderful animals - a magical moment!

blocks.orig: After an amazing time with the chimpanzees, it is time to embark on your journey from Mahale back to Kigoma. This beautiful and adventurous journey by boat and car takes approximately eight hours.
blocks.html: After your wonderful days with the chimpanzees, you set off from Mahale back to Kigoma. The scenic, adventurous trip by boat and road takes around eight hours.

blocks.orig: This is your last day! Today you fly to Julius Nyerere International Airport in Dar Es Salaam, from where you will catch your international flight home. Having second thoughts? Then don't hesitate to extend your holiday to one of Tanzania's paradise islands such as Zanzibar, Pemba, or Mafia!
blocks.html: Your final day has come! Today you fly to Julius Nyerere International Airport in Dar Es Salaam to board your international flight home. Not ready to leave? Then feel free to add some time on one of Tanzania's paradise islands, such as Zanzibar, Pemba or Mafia!
